mapper.select: /* IInqryMapper.getList */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY abp.reg_dttm DESC) rnum , abp.post_no postNo /* 게시글번호 */ , abp.board_no boardNo /* 게시판번호 */ , abp.ttl ttl /* 제목 */ , abp.cn cn /* 내용 */ , abp.wrtr_id wrtrId /* 작성자아이디 */ , abp.prrt_cd prrtCd /* 문의유형코드 */ , abp.reg_dttm regDttm /* 등록일시 */ , abp.mdf_dttm mdfDttm /* 수정일시 */ , abp.inq_cnt inqCnt /* 조회수 */ , abp.del_yn delYn /* 삭제여부 */ , abp.atch_file_id atchFileId /* 첨부파일아이디 */ , abp.opn_yn opnYn /* 공개여부 */ , abi.apt_cmplex_no aptCmplexNo /* 아파트단지번호 */ , abi.board_ty_cd boardTyCd /* 게시판유형코드 */ , abi.board_nm boardNm /* 게시판명 */ FROM apt_board_post abp JOIN apt_board_instance abi ON abp.board_no = abi.board_no WHERE abi.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND abi.board_ty_cd = #{boardTyCd} AND abi.use_yn = 'Y' AND abp.del_yn = 'N' AND abp.wrtr_id = #{wrtrId} ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

/* IInqryMapper.getBoardNo */ SELECT MAX(abi.board_no) FROM apt_board_instance abi WHERE TRIM(abi.apt_cmplex_no) = TRIM(#{aptCmplexNo}) AND TRIM(abi.board_ty_cd) = TRIM(#{boardTyCd}) AND TRIM(abi.use_yn) = 'Y'

/* IInqryMapper.getResidentInfo */ SELECT hh.user_no userNo /* 사용자번호 */ , hh.ho_no hoNo /* 세대번호 */ , au.apt_cmplex_no aptCmplexNo /* 아파트단지번호 */ FROM hshld_head hh JOIN apt_detail ad ON hh.ho_no = ad.ho_no JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE hh.user_no = #{userNo} AND ROWNUM = 1

/* IInqryMapper.detail */
SELECT abp.post_no postNo , abp.board_no boardNo , abp.ttl ttl , abp.cn cn , abp.wrtr_id wrtrId , abp.prrt_cd prrtCd , abp.reg_dttm regDttm , abp.mdf_dttm mdfDttm , abp.inq_cnt inqCnt , abp.del_yn delYn , abp.atch_file_id atchFileId , abp.opn_yn opnYn FROM apt_board_post abp WHERE abp.post_no = #{postNo} AND abp.wrtr_id = #{userId} AND abp.del_yn = 'N'
